cases.scenario: A durable fact arrives from a source the wiki does not cover
expected: Raw source saved under wiki/sources/<domain>/ with its link
One page written or updated, current state first
One index line and one log entry
forbidden: A page longer than the raw it replaces

cases.scenario: The source is already covered by an existing page
expected: The existing page is updated in place
forbidden: A second page on the same topic

cases.scenario: A reference question has no page and no obvious source
expected: Say the wiki does not hold it
Offer to ingest the source, or ask for it
forbidden: Answering from memory as if the wiki had said it

cases.scenario: A page has grown longer than the source it summarises
expected: Slim the page to the shortest accurate version
Move depth into sources and the log
forbidden: Keeping the page as the new source of record

cases.scenario: The index names a page that no longer exists
expected: The entry is fixed or the page restored
forbidden: Leaving the index as an approximation
